Restores the file or directory to its original location. overwrite is required: true sends 1 and allows replacing the on-disk item, while false sends 0. path is an absolute path within the backup and must begin with /. The source requires proper filename parsing to prevent XSS. This mutation has no automatic retry or rollback.

backupId accepts documented daily date, incremental, weekly/date, monthly/date, weekly/incremental and monthly/incremental selectors. The optional payload success flag describes the overwrite outcome separately from UAPI status; inspect both and retain success=0.

On cPanel 11.138.0.19 with server backups disabled, the reviewed direct and bridged calls failed with the upstream Backup Status is currently disabled error.
